about: The one rule for a text cut at a word (session.CutAtWord, dispatch's cutAtWord, the app's copy): s whole when it fits chars characters (and bytes bytes, when bytes is not 0); else cut to chars - 1 characters (and bytes - 3 bytes) at the last space after keep characters, trailing spaces trimmed, and an ellipsis (U+2026) added; a first word past the bound is cut at a character.
